short_description:
Where to find GTA 6's UFO: a country road just east of Port Gellhorn, in Kelly County (guides also say northwest of the Starlet Motel). Go alone after 2 AM, from Chapter 2 on, and look for an abandoned car with flashing lights on the roadside. It doesn't happen every night, so try again the next one. No story spoilers. Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides → GTA 6 Map).

📍 Map Spot #18 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Map: Rockstar Games' official Leonida map. Sources: PowerPyx, The Click, Game8, GameSpot, Red Bull.

facts_note: Nov 24 map research (2+ guides): east of Port Gellhorn / NW of the Starlet Motel (both right; the motel isn't printed on Rockstar's map, so the pin marks the area east of town); after 2 AM (Dexerto's '2 PM' is the outlier); from Chapter 2 (= after Chapter 1); alone; not every night. The follow-up (alien base, keypad) is left out on purpose: it's the payoff.
